Hedwig

Website

Who they are

Hedwig is an AI-native inbox — email + calendar on an infinite canvas (frames, piles, stickies, and AI agents you arrange into an inbox that works exactly how you do), built by Stanford students and one of the fastest-growing AI startups.

What they want

  • Founding Growth Marketer (freelance) — help grow one of the fastest-growing AI startups; $2–3k/mo base + performance bonuses (top performers $6k+), with a path into a long-term leadership role.
  • What you'll do: launch & test growth campaigns across social media, communities, partnerships, and campus organizations; create strategies that drive user growth + creator signups; experiment with new acquisition channels.
  • Angle for content: show the AI-native inbox solving a real 'my inbox runs itself' moment — help shape the brand of a fast-growing AI startup from the ground up.
  • Vibe: creative, experimental, founder-adjacent; native to short-form (study the competitors + keyword content below for what performs in the AI-email / productivity space).
